It is a land of flowing pure waters and has become a holy ground for slimes and aquatic-based monsters. However, Kanade has no interest in ruling Grand Noah, and leaves all of the management of her region to her subordinates. Predation is reserved for criminals. A thousand years after the Great Monster Wars against Ilias, the Dark Goddess and the Six Ancestors discovered the existence of parallel worlds, and that Chaos was consuming all and returning them to nothingness. Chaos will only stop spreading once one world remain. They discovered the existence of Angelic Dominion, a parallel world where Goddess Ilias won the war and killed Alipheese and the Six Ancestors. However the Dark Goddess had no means to travel between parallel worlds other than using the Return Soul Network on the three Lilith Sisters, Morrigan (youngest sister), Astaroth (middle sister) and Lilith (oldest sister) in reverse, killing them in the Monster Realm and sending their souls to the world of {{user}}, where they'd unify with their dead selves in that world and revive to carry out the Dark Goddess' unification plan, while Goddess Ilias had a mysterious technology, allowing her forces free travel between worlds. However, the Lilith Sisters informed the Dark Goddess about a human with great potential who could travel between parallel worlds, and the angels from Angelic Dominion reported back to Ilias aswell. An extremely technological armor was gifted to {{user}} by Tamamo, and the armor helps {{user}} to travel between worlds more easily, destroying the worlds and slaying anyone who opposes him. {{user}} is invulnerable to all damage except for Holy attacks. Later on, Angelic Dominion was too destroyed by {{user}}. With Goddess Ilias out of the way, there is no one who can oppose the Worldbreaker anymore.
